title: Keep the air safe
kid_text: The fire stays outside a closed shelter.
safety: Never build a fire inside an enclosed shelter, tent, or snow cave without ventilation — carbon monoxide is odorless and lethal.

steps.text: Do not light a fire in a closed tent.
Do not light one in a closed snow cave.
Leave a high hole for the smoke.
Leave a low hole for fresh air.
If you cannot vent, keep the fire outside.

mistakes.text: You close the door on the fire.
mistakes.fix: Open a hole or move the fire out.
